payload.answer: Treat them differently, because they differ in whether anything is running. READY and AWAITING_HUMAN are inert: transition straight to CANCELLED, no race, no worker to consider. AWAITING_CAPACITY likewise. LEASED is the only hard one -- a live worker holds it and may be minutes into a paid session. Do not yank the row out from under it. Behind --force, mark the intent and let the lease drain, exactly as the SIGTERM drain already does for scale-in: the worker finishes the job in hand and claims no more. Without --force, refuse and name the leased jobs. SUCCEEDED and FAILED are terminal history and must not be rewritten -- the ledger is append-only, and retroactively cancelling a job that already succeeded would falsify the record.
